meta.name: genomic-coordinates
meta.description: Convert genomic intervals between coordinate conventions, normalise and compare variant representations, and detect assembly or contig-naming mismatches before they corrupt an analysis. Use whenever coordinates cross a format, tool, or assembly boundary - converting between BED, GFF/GTF, VCF, SAM/BAM, WIG, PSL, genePred, Picard interval_list, or region strings; reconciling 0-based half-open with 1-based inclusive; left-aligning or trimming indels; checking whether two variant records describe the same change; mapping genomic to transcript, CDS, or protein positions; auditing a BED/GTF/VCF for convention violations; or diagnosing GRCh37 vs hg19 vs GRCh38 vs T2T, chr-prefix, and liftover problems. Triggers include "off by one", "0-based", "1-based", "half-open", "coordinate system", "left-align", "normalize variant", "bcftools norm", "chr prefix", "wrong genome build", "liftover", "REF mismatch", and "HGVS".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把不同标准的基因位置统一起来，避免分析出错
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常处理基因数据，总被不同位置标注弄晕。
copy.tagline_en: Unify genomic coordinates between different formats to avoid mismatches.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with genomic position data and often get confused by coordinate differences.

howto.what: Claude 将用内置脚本转换 0-based 半开/1-based 闭合坐标,把变异规范化并左对齐,核对染色体命名与组装版本,审计 BED/GTF/VCF 等区间文件格式;最后报告转换方向、比对结论和退出码。
howto.when: 当坐标需要在格式、工具或基因组组装之间跨边界时触发,例如坐标换算、变异比较或组装版本核对;用户说出“off by one”“liftover”等触发词也会触发。

say.text: 把附件 BED 转成 GFF/GTF 的 1-based 闭合坐标。
say.note: 会调用坐标转换脚本并给出新坐标。

say.text: 帮我归一化这两个变异,再判断是否代表同一改变。
say.note: 会先 trim 到最简再左对齐,之后比较。

say.text: 看看我的 VCF 和 GTF 是否同属 GRCh38,染色体命名有无冲突。
say.note: 会运行 check_contigs,报告命名和长度差异。

howto.what_en: Claude uses bundled scripts to convert coordinate conventions, normalize and left-align indels, detect assembly/contig mismatches, and audit BED/GTF/VCF files, reporting results and exit codes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when coordinates cross a format, tool, or assembly boundary, e.g., coordinate conversion, variant normalization, or assembly checking; also on keywords like "off by one" and "liftover".

say_en.text: Convert the attached BED file to GFF/GTF with 1-based inclusive coordinates.
say_en.note: Runs convert_coords and returns new coordinates.

say_en.text: Normalize these two variants, then tell me if they are the same change.
Check whether my VCF and GTF are both GRCh38 and whether contig names conflict.
